findings.title: Removed await stores a Promise as the L1 fee.
findings.body: Same problem as in TransactionReview: without `await`, the result is a Promise rather than a fee value, and errors escape the try/catch as unhandled rejections. Restore `await`.

findings.title: Removed await stores a Promise as the L1 fee.
findings.body: `fetchEstimatedMultiLayerL1Fee` is async, so `multiLayerL1FeeTotal` becomes a Promise instead of a hex string. The fee display breaks, and rejections are no longer caught by the try/catch. Restore `await`.

findings.title: Removed awaits on onReject/onConfirm.
findings.body: The notification and the SIGNATURE_APPROVED/REJECTED metrics now fire before signing completes, even if it fails. A failed sign is reported as approved, and rejections become unhandled. Restore `await`.

findings.title: Object.assign copy of the store and persistor may miss non-enumerable or prototype members.
findings.body: Any member not copied leaves `store`/`persistor` broken, and before init they are empty objects, so calls such as `store.getState` throw a TypeError instead of failing an undefined check. For example, `store?.getState()` in Sentry now throws. Consider exporting a getter instead.
